en.title: Moral panic, evangelical fury and a culture war: The Bolsonaro formula threatens Lula's re-election bid
en.summary: Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest for a coup attempt, has endorsed his son Flávio as the right-wing presidential candidate. Despite being less charismatic than his father, Flávio has tied President Lula in polls by centering moral issues and portraying the left as a threat to faith and family.
